entries.829f93e0cf12b3b6: This is a single reportable segment conducted by a group of nine companies: the company, five consolidated subsidiaries, one unconsolidated subsidiary and two affiliates not accounted for by the equity method. It provides surveys, planning, proposals, design and construction supervision relating to civil engineering, architecture, surveying, geology and soil mechanics, as well as consulting services related to these. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥38,064 million, of which the Construction Consulting Business accounted for ¥33,358 million and the Geological Survey Business for ¥4,705 million. The core company is the consolidated subsidiary Dai Nippon Dia Consultants Co., Ltd.
